mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means the money which moves in and out of the business."
Cash flow means the money which moves in and out of the business.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a sole trader or has many employees, introducing internal controls will ensure that the business runs more efficiently, resources are not lost and there are fewer unpleasant surprises."

Whether a business is a sole trader or has many employees, introducing internal controls will ensure that the business runs more efficiently, resources are not lost and there are fewer unpleasant surprises.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an important asset of any business."
Accounts receivable is an important asset of any business.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with the control operative in every areas of corporate activity."
Internal control system is concerned with the control operative in every areas of corporate activity.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are responsible to management to whom they report, whereas the statutory auditor is primarily responsible to the shareholders to whom he reports."
The internal auditors are responsible to management to whom they report, whereas the statutory auditor is primarily responsible to the shareholders to whom he reports.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the current and prospective risk to earnings or capital arising from a debtor's failure to meet the terms of any contract with the organisation or otherwise to perform as agreed."
Credit risk is the current and prospective risk to earnings or capital arising from a debtor's failure to meet the terms of any contract with the organisation or otherwise to perform as agreed.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those developed to meet the need of every circumstance while special audit programmes are developed for a specific situation."
Standard audit programmes are those developed to meet the need of every circumstance while special audit programmes are developed for a specific situation.
fib: ______ is a method through which employees' remuneration can be controlled.
A good payroll system is a method through which employees' remuneration can be controlled.
______ is the tracing of transactions from inception of the records to the conclusion.
A work-through test is the tracing of transactions from inception of the records to the conclusion.
______ is the medium by which the internal auditor's views are conveyed to the board of directors and the management.
Internal audit report is the medium by which the internal auditor's views are conveyed to the board of directors and the management.
______ is the risk to earnings or capital arising from violations of or nonconformance with laws, rules, regulations, prescribed practices, or ethical standards.
Compliance risk is the risk to earnings or capital arising from violations of or nonconformance with laws, rules, regulations, prescribed practices, or ethical standards.
______ is an independent appraisal function within an organisation for the review of activities, in order to review the accounting systems and related internal controls.
Internal audit is an independent appraisal function within an organisation for the review of activities, in order to review the accounting systems and related internal controls.

______ is the current and prospective risk to earnings and capital arising from fraud, error, and the inability to deliver products or services, maintain a competitive position, and manage information.

Transaction risk is the current and prospective risk to earnings and capital arising from fraud, error, and the inability to deliver products or services, maintain a competitive position, and manage information.
